messages:
anna: Heads-up — quick design sync at 2pm. Need to settle default for the Usage page: a compact spend summary card (sparklines + single-line token metric) or an expanded ledger view (row per project + CSV/PDF exports)? Quick reactions pls.

mike: Compact as the default. Keep ledger behind a toggle/secondary view. Dashboard should be scannable. :eyes:

lia: Compact default + persistent toggle per-org sounds good. One hard requirement: make the token unit explicit — people confuse 'tokens' with 'input vs output tokens'.

anna: Agreed. @mike can you add microcopy under the metric: `Tokens used (input + output)`? Also we should offer a tooltip that breaks down input vs output on hover.

oliver: From billing/reconcile POV ledger is important — customers want invoice rows to line up with ledger rows. If we hide ledger too deep it makes support harder.

billing-bot: Invoice export available in staging: <https://staging.redwood/invoices/export/2025-09-05.csv> — size capped at 10k rows, streaming supported.

mike: UI nit: negative adjustments are red but fail contrast AA at 12px. Either darken the red or add a small icon (▼) so color isn't the only cue.

lia: Accessibility notes: the toggle to switch to ledger needs an ARIA label like `aria-label="Show per-project ledger"`. Also ensure keyboard focus order is logical (toggle -> export button -> chart controls).

anna: Copy tweak: change button text from `Get invoice` to `Download invoice (PDF)` — clearer for end users.

oliver: Also add a tax/VAT line in ledger rows and invoice exports. Some EMEA customers require explicit per-country VAT breakdown.

mike: For the main chart on the Usage page — stacked area (org-level trend) vs grouped bar (project comparison). Stacked area shows overall trend + share, grouped bar makes exact comparisons easier.

lia: Maybe default to stacked area with rich hover tooltips that show exact per-project numbers. Add a visible control `Switch to grouped bars` for power users.

anna: Decision for the 2pm sync: default = compact spend summary card + stacked area overview. Add a persistent per-org toggle that opens the ledger table (with CSV & PDF exports, tax line, invoice link). Accessibility and copy fixes as noted. @mike @lia please produce mocks + spec.

mike: I'll push the Figma frames and annotate aria-labels + contrast adjustments. ETA today EOD.

lia: I'll add a backend flag `ledger_view=true` and extend the billing API to include per-project token counts and tax fields. PR will include sample CSV column order. Linking PR: http://git.internal/payment-api/pulls/678

oliver: We'll add streaming for large exports and surface an `export_status` webhook for long jobs. Also will include invoice reconciliation fields in the billing API response.

anna: Great work — post-review checklist: unit tests for CSV column order, accessibility checklist in PR, and a short note in the release notes about the new default + toggle.

mike: noted. I'll add the accessibility checklist as a TODO in the Figma file and copy doc. :white_check_mark:

lia: I'll include sample CSV (10 rows) in the PR so QA can verify mapping to invoices.

anna: Thanks team — see you at 2.
